target_customer: Accounting and bookkeeping firms and other professional service firms, from solo practitioners to multi-seat practices
problem: Accounting firms juggle separate tools for proposals, engagement letters, billing, payments, tasks and client requests.
business_model: B2B SaaS per user subscription (a 2024 article puts Cone Practice at 8 USD and Cone Propose at 13 USD per user per month)
product_category: Accounting practice management, proposals and billing software

founders.name: Jahangir Mohammed
education: MS Computer Science, Stony Brook University
previous_startups: Joveo, hiring platform, grew from 4 to 300 employees

founders.name: Bharath Kumar Reddy
education: Bachelor's and Master's in Electrical Engineering, IIT Madras
previous_startups: adaptive.team, OKR management through conversational bots

competitors.name: Karbon
competitors.what: Practice management and workflow software for accounting firms
competitors.funding_then: Reported 66M USD raise led by Tidemark in February 2022 (another aggregator shows different round details)

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow, billing and payments SaaS with integrations to accounting software. Mostly standard CRUD and integration work for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Practice management products overlap heavily with several established vendors, and the proposal and billing wedge is easy to copy; only workflow data creates mild lock-in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded practice management vendors already covered the space; Cone broadened from Propose into Practice in January 2024 to compete directly.

market_need_then: Accounting firms had a recognized need for practice management, proposals and billing tools, shown by active vendors such as Karbon raising large rounds in early 2022.

branding.domain_note: Uses getcone.io, not cone.com, suggesting the exact domain was unavailable; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Product-led, accountant-focused messaging such as work reimagined for accounting firms

brand_strength.rationale: A search for the name returns unrelated companies called Cone (a London accounting practice, a PR firm); no press about the brand itself.

pivots.from: Proposal, billing and payments product (Cone Propose)
pivots.to: Added practice and project management (Cone Practice)
pivots.why: Not stated; per a directory timeline and the 2024 product launch coverage

outcome_analysis: Cone is an eight person Hyderabad company selling accounting workflow software. It raised a reported 1.65M USD pre-seed in 2023 per aggregators, launched Propose in 2024 and added Practice, and claims thousands of accountant users. It entered a crowded market against well funded vendors, so the story is still unresolved and no clear success or failure factor is supported by sources.
notes: The 2023 round is from aggregators only (Inc42 says April 2023 at 1.65M USD pre-seed; TheCompanyCheck says about 1.66M USD in March 2023; YesPress says about 1.83M total with General Catalyst and Khosla Ventures, unverified and not recorded). Treat the amount as unverified by a primary source. Karbon funding details conflict across aggregators. No shutdown, acquisition or layoff news found.
